description: This file defines the RestJsonSerializer class used for serializing requests for the REST-JSON protocol in AWS SDK. It extends RestSerializer and manages JSON formatting and HTTP headers for request payloads.

classes.name: RestJsonSerializer
classes.description: A serializer that converts request data into JSON format suitable for REST-JSON AWS services, handling content type and request body formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serializer with the API description, endpoint, and optional JSON formatter.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Prepares the request payload by serializing the data into JSON and setting appropriate HTTP headers.
